summary: Confirmed all 24 estimates against the paper and the extraction rules. Read the complete 706-line markdown conversion through the final references; the paper contains no appendix. Extracted the text of every cited PDF page and visually inspected Figures 1 and 7 in memory. The seven peer-rated outcomes are reported for Task 1, Task 2 and both tasks combined. Figure 7 supplies bars and unspecified error bars without exact numerical values, so null statistics and unclear se_basis are appropriate. Table 3 confirms the task and overall idea counts, including the condition totals retained in the fluency notes; Figure 1 confirms that control and experimental labels refer to current assistance conditions after the crossover. The 51-person cohort and 728 peer-assessed ideas are supported on pages 16 and 14, respectively. Checked outcome coding, units, direction, AI availability, timing, comparison type and crossover tags. Table 4 compares nonrandom prior-experience groups and is correctly excluded, as are self-reports and qualitative reflections. No additional eligible outcome or full-sample contrast was found. The already-noted discrepancy between Table 4 subgroup counts and Table 3 does not establish an error in the extracted randomized contrasts.
